details: Adolescent E: REMAKE (too short, too white/bright). New Adolescent F keeps E's purple + sturdy feel at the current Adolescent's tall height. Legend E is still in the app (v0.148) but Ash cancelled that confirm 2026-11-05; new Legend F would replace it. Keep current is available for both stages. Nothing ships until Ash confirms.
